# Field Test Finding / Specification Candidate Input

> Use this template for findings from practical use of the framework. A
> finding does **not** need to propose a normative change. Where a
> normative change appears necessary, this issue provides structured
> input for later controlled SCP assessment.
>
> Do not edit the normative specification directly through this issue.
